title: install-local: a composed artifact with a package dependency cycle answers an opaque 500 instead of naming the cycle
body:
repo:objectstack#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQ2SN4K183oqAvUajA

Filing gate ①: a class a candidate, from the final report on card #34432 (PR #34573), passed on by area `o2-D`. Dedupe: `composed artifact dependency cycle 500`, `resolvePluginOrder Circular dependency install-local`; no open card.

reach (half measured): on a real runtime, `POST /api/v1/marketplace/install-local` with a composed artifact whose two packages depend on each other makes the handler throw a bare `Error("[Kernel] Circular dependency detected: PKG")`. The throw was measured. That the transport then answers `500 INTERNAL_ERROR` with no reason was read from `installErrorEnvelopeSeam` in plugin-hono-server `adapter.ts` and was not measured. Evidence: the file header of runtime `artifact-collections.ts` records the cycle as a bare Error (`resolveArtifactPackageOrder` / `resolveArtifactCollections`).

Suggested-grade: p2 · `domain:server` · `pm:queue` (the claimant measures the 500 first)

## 维护者速读

- 现象：本地安装一个组合制品时，如果里面两个包互相依赖，接口只回一个不带原因的 500。作者不知道问题是循环依赖。
- 为什么要修：安装失败要告诉作者哪里错了、怎么改;不透明的 500 只能去翻服务端日志。
- 需要你做的：无。

## Change

Turn the cycle into a typed refusal that names the packages in the cycle, at the same door and with the same envelope as the resolver's other refusals (422 with a code and the cycle path). Do not add a second error shape. Pin it with an install-local test on a two-package cycle.

## Done when

The pin test gets a 4xx with a code and the cycle's package names, and no bare Error reaches the transport.
